mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CWGL_Deposit_Info( Dio_ID, Dio_DsID, Dio_Deposit_Total, Dio_Unpaid, Dio_Contract_ID, Dio_Source_Type ) VALUES ( #{Dio_ID}, 1, 0, #{Dio_Unpaid}, #{Contract_ID}, #{Dio_Source_Type} )
mapper.select:
SELECT A.Dio_ID, A.Dio_DsID, A.Dio_Deposit_Total, A.Dio_Unpaid, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS c_time, B.c_name, B.c_fatName, B.c_userName, B.c_userId, B.c_other_amount, B.c_contract_amount, B.c_the_actual_amount, DATE_FORMAT(C.Dids_Time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS Dids_Time, C.Dids_Amount, C.Dids_FatName, C.Dids_Remarks FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B, cwgl_deposit_info_details C
ORDER BY C.Dids_Time DESC,B.c_time DESC LIMIT #{StarRow},#{PageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B, cwgl_deposit_info_details C

SELECT A.Dio_ID, A.Dio_DsID, A.Dio_Deposit_Total, A.Dio_Unpaid, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS c_time, B.c_name, B.c_fatName, B.c_userName, B.c_userId, B.c_other_amount, B.c_contract_amount, B.c_the_actual_amount, DATE_FORMAT(C.Dids_Time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS Dids_Time, C.Dids_Amount, C.Dids_FatName, C.Dids_Remarks FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B, cwgl_deposit_info_details C
ORDER BY C.Dids_Time DESC,B.c_time DESC

SELECT A.Dio_ID, A.Dio_Contract_ID, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS Time, B.c_contract_amount AS Prepaid_Amount, B.c_the_actual_amount AS The_Actual_Amount, B.c_name AS CoName, B.c_name AS FatName, A.Dio_DsID, A.Dio_Deposit_Total, A.Dio_Unpaid, c_userId AS USERID, c_userName AS NAME, C_discount AS discount, c_id AS CoID FROM CWGL_Deposit_Info A, yz_xsgl_contract B
A.Dio_Contract_ID=B.code AND Dio_ID=#{Dio_ID}

SELECT A.Dio_ID, A.Dio_DsID, A.Dio_Deposit_Total, A.Dio_Unpaid, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS c_time, B.c_userId, B.c_name, B.c_fatName, B.c_userName, B.c_other_amount, B.c_contract_amount, B.c_the_actual_amount FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B
ORDER BY c_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B

SELECT A.Dio_ID, A.Dio_DsID, A.Dio_Deposit_Total, A.Dio_Unpaid, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS c_time, B.c_userId, B.c_name, B.c_fatName, B.c_userName, B.c_other_amount, B.c_contract_amount, B.c_the_actual_amount FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B

SELECT YEAR (c_time) AS y_Time, SUM(Dio_Deposit_Total) AS Dio_Deposit_Total, SUM(Dio_Unpaid) AS Dio_Unpaid, A.Dio_DsID, B.c_userId, B.c_name, B.c_fatName, DATE_FORMAT(B.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS c_time FROM CWGL_Deposit_Info A, yz_xsgl_contract B
GROUP BY y_Time

SELECT YEAR (c_time) AS y_Time, DATE_FORMAT(c_time, '%Y-%m') AS M_Time, DATE_FORMAT(c_time, '%m') AS M, SUM(Dio_Deposit_Total) AS M_Dio_Deposit_Total, SUM(Dio_Unpaid) AS M_Dio_Unpaid FROM CWGL_Deposit_Info A, yz_xsgl_contract B
GROUP BY M_Time
SELECT MAX(substring(Dio_ID, 13, 4)) from CWGL_Deposit_Info where substring(Dio_ID, 5, 8) = NOW()

SELECT Dio_Deposit_Total > 0 AS da_yu_0, Dio_Deposit_Total = 0 AS deng_yu_0, Dio_Deposit_Total >= #{Dio_Unpaid} AS da_yu_Unpaid FROM CWGL_Deposit_Info
Dio_Contract_ID=#{Contract_ID}
SELECT SUM(A.Dio_Unpaid) as 'sumDio_Unpaid' FROM cwgl_deposit_info A, yz_xsgl_contract B, cwgl_deposit_info_details C
